# o9Tech

> o9Tech is a product engineering studio in Lahore, Pakistan, founded in 2022. We build native iOS and Android apps, cross-platform apps, web platforms, data pipelines and AI features for clients around the world.

Contact: info@o9tech.com, +92 345 6259449. Office: Office No. 8, 3rd Floor, Abbas Trade Center, Lahore 54000, Pakistan.

## Services

- [Native iOS & Android](https://o9tech.com/service-mobile): Fast, polished native apps that feel at home on every iPhone and Android phone.
- [Cross-Platform Apps](https://o9tech.com/service-cross-platform): One codebase, two stores, no compromise on feel.
- [Full-Stack Web Platforms](https://o9tech.com/service-web): Web apps, dashboards and APIs that hold up under real traffic.
- [AI Development](https://o9tech.com/service-ai): Practical AI features that ship inside real products.
- [Data Engineering](https://o9tech.com/service-data-engineering): Clean, reliable data that your team and your AI can trust.
- [Blockchain & Web3](https://o9tech.com/service-blockchain): On-chain systems where trust and proof actually matter.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://o9tech.com/service-cloud): Infrastructure and release pipelines you never have to think about.

## Our apps

- [Hue Pour](https://o9tech.com/hue-pour): A paint mixing puzzle where blue and yellow make green, like real paint.
- [Pigeon Post](https://o9tech.com/pigeon-post): Send pigeons to real cities. They come home with postcards.

## Case studies

- [Worlds: Memory Journals](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-worlds): Private and shared memory journals for couples, friends and family.
- [Trading Card TV](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-tradingcardtv): Live card breaks, auctions and trades for sports and Pokemon fans.
- [AirLister](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-airlister): Sell, rent or buy Australian property direct, with no middleman.
- [TriageX](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-triagex): Rule-based symptom triage that points patients to the right care.
- [Pryvate Messenger](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-pryvatemessenger): Encrypted calls, chats and email in one private messenger.
- [HiiKER](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-hiiker): Hiking maps, multi-day route planning and offline navigation.
- [Beyon Money](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-beyonmoney): Bahrain's money app for cards, transfers and savings.
- [Votari](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-votari): Private, verifiable voting with results anchored on the blockchain.
- [Venn Social: Find Your People](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-venn): A supportive community app that finds your people and your circles.
- [BeatYou: Habit Tracker & Goals](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-beatyou): Build habits, challenge friends and pledge to charity to stay accountable.
- [Going Solo](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-goingsolo): Meet solo travelers nearby, plan trips and find a travel buddy.
- [DriverFly](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-driverfly): Automated driver hiring and DOT compliance for carriers.
- [AI-Powered Health & Wellness Platform](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-health-ai): Personal wellness plans driven by AI recommendations.
- [Resumifi AI Resume Builder](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-resumifi): An AI resume builder that writes ATS-ready resumes.
- [DaBot Data Pipeline Automation](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-dabot): AI that onboards data and automates the pipelines behind it.
- [AI WhatsApp Lead Conversion Chatbot](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-leadbot): An AI chatbot that turns WhatsApp group chats into qualified leads.
- [Dubai Mall App](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-dubaimallapp): Stores, dining, offers and indoor maps for the Dubai Mall.
- [KFH Bahrain](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-kfhbahrain): Islamic mobile banking with fully digital onboarding.
- [The Boubyan App](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-boubyanbank): Mobile banking for one of Kuwait's leading Islamic banks.
- [Jeeny](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-jeeny): Affordable everyday rides across Saudi Arabia and Jordan.
- [Block: Focus on What Matters](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-blockapp): Tap a physical Block to lock distracting apps and focus.
- [Officetree Phone](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-officetreephone): A full business phone line on the smartphone you already carry.
- [Reserval](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-reserval): Book cruises, hotels and flights in one Saudi travel app.
- [NPFL Live](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-npfllive): Live streams and highlights of Nigeria's top football league.
- [Kohinoor Fabric Library](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-kohinoorfabriclibrary): Browse, filter and order Kohinoor Mills fabrics from an iPhone.
- [Routinsie: Routine Planner](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-routinsie): A habit tracker and daily routine planner.
- [MealSmash](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-mealsmash): Order from local restaurants and track delivery in real time.
- [Ziply On-Demand](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-ziply): Door-to-door courier delivery for local businesses.
- [Courier Logistics Platform](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-courier): Driver and merchant apps plus an operations dashboard for a delivery company.
- [Gravity Social Calendar](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-gravity): Plan and schedule social content across platforms.
- [Thoubak](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-thoubak): Book a tailor to measure you at home, then get your thobe delivered.
- [Gravel Parking](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-gravel): Find a parking spot nearby, or earn money from your empty one.
- [Stay Seated](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-stayseated): Order food and drinks at the game and get them brought to your seat.
- [Hookah Butler](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-hookahbutler): Order a hookah from your phone and have it brought to your table.
- [Scissors](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-scissors): Find and book barbers, salons and beauty pros near you.
- [Kuluna Daaya](https://o9tech.com/portfolio-kulunadaaya): Share Islamic learning bags and earn points as people learn.
